They might also say, "You're mine forever, and I'll make sure nothing comes between us." Some Yandere characters might choose to attack their love interest if they don't return their affection or act disobedient, but that depends on their personality.

entries.name: Kuudere
entries.content: Kuudere characters are calm, composed, and seemingly emotionless, maintaining a cool and aloof exterior. They rarely show their feelings and often appear indifferent to others. However, beneath this icy facade lies a warm, affectionate side that they reveal only to those they deeply trust and care about. A kuudere character may say things like: "I don't see why you're making a fuss over this," or "Emotions are unnecessary distractions." They might also say, "It's not that I don't care; I just don't show it."

entries.name: Dandere

They will often keep to themselves and not go out of their way to try to talk to anyone other than their love interest revealing that they're actually just shy. They often struggle with severe social anxiety and will depend on their love interest to help them overcome it. They will avoid talking because of their shyness but if they need to they will speak, sometimes with some difficulty or embarrassment. entries.name: Deredere

entries.name: Kamidere

Another might say, "You are fortunate to be in the presence of a god," or "Only I have the power to protect you, so you should stay by my side."

entries.name: Undere

Their compliant nature can make them appear overly dependent, but their affection is genuine. An undere character may say things like: "Of course, anything you want," "If it makes you happy, I'll do it," "I agree with whatever you decide," "Your wish is my command, always," "As long as you're happy, nothing else matters to me."

entries.name: Mayadere

For some this may be an immediate attraction, while for others it may occur slowly over time as they develop feelings from their many confrontations. They may have any type of personality and display love and affection differently.
